entries.name: Gordon Lau Harris

expected.charges: Freedom Ride participation — arrived by train from New Orleans, arrested Jackson, June 25, 1961.
expected.convicted: Unresolved — the arrest is documented; the disposition is not established in the CRDL record
expected.sentence: Arrested 1961-06-25. The Civil Rights Digital Library establishes the arrest and the identification photograph but not the disposition, any transfer to Parchman, or the release date — unresolved pending court, jail, or penitentiary records.

updates.sentence: Four months and a $200 fine. The Historic Brighton account, citing contemporary newspaper coverage and his December 1961 talk, confirms jailing after the June 25 Freedom Ride and subsequent transfer to Parchman. The individual release date remains unverified.

entries.name: Janice Louise Rogers

expected.charges: Breach of the peace — Freedom Ride arrival at the Jackson Illinois Central terminal, June 25, 1961.
expected.convicted: Convicted — she was imprisoned at Parchman, where the catalog reports she miscarried
expected.sentence: Arrested June 25, 1961; imprisoned at Parchman, where the Civil Rights Digital Library reports she miscarried. Her sentence length and release date are unresolved pending court or penitentiary records.

updates.sentence: The Civil Rights Digital Library confirms imprisonment at Parchman following the June 25, 1961 Freedom Ride arrest. The sentence length and individual release date remain unverified.
